scorecard.notes: Only auditor who ran the gates. I confirmed its numbers: preflight 46 pass, 3 fail, 3 skip, and R1-12a now passes (15/15 in r1_defects_test.dart). It correctly found that the AR pages carry the same 7/2/2 placeholders under a different marker, that the C09b text 'nothing is kept except a hash' (arb:2830) is false against privacy section 6 and the 180-day retention, and that privacy:313 claims consent comes 'before your data leaves your phone' while C06 sends the number with no consent. The HealthFitness key point is well taken (Apple's keys are Health and Fitness). It only guessed the other two preflight FAILs; they are the missing keystore and the empty team id.

Most unique, verified findings. verificationBehaviour, verificationInstalls and the review access log survive deletion and are missing from privacy section 6 (deletion.py:40-42). The safety centre's 'A woman on the team, 9am to 9pm' (arb:383) contradicts support:47-50, which says Mahmoud, Sunday to Thursday, 9 to 5. meals and eatPrefs have allow delete: if false. The assistant wire carries allergies and avoid tags. The flag webhook goes to an undisclosed chat service. The checklist cites a LAW-20 that does not exist. Two points overreach: 'wording changed without a version bump' (the disclosure bullets are unchanged) and 'no man ever sees' (admin flag rows hold no face, card or name).

Precise, verified journey counts: 0 taps and 0 records for Terms acceptance, the policy reachable from 0 screens, delete 2 taps from Profile. Correct AR placeholder lines. It caught the play-data-safety.txt:14 path 'Profile and settings > delete account' against the real 'Your data' row, the three conflicting deletion-timing strings, and the missing locale in write_consent. Its RTL bidi point is reasonable. It treats severity a little lightly in places.

Its protected list is good and accurate. It made factual errors: AR pages 'show 0 placeholders / diverge' (they carry the same 11 under [بانتظار الاستكمال]); it listed the manifest types without CrashData (declared at PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy:133); and it said the assistant wire carries no health data (it carries allergies and avoid tags). It also marked APL-10 a pass without noting the meals and eatPrefs delete gaps. The Info.plist:27 'deleted after the check' finding is correct and useful.

Best prioritisation and the two-track plan (owner critical path vs about 4 days of code), but it verified little itself because its grep was broken. It repeated the checklist's stale 'R1-12a fails' (the test passes). F4 claims that 'no analytics' while Crashlytics runs is a misrepresentation; that is weak, because crash reporting is disclosed in section 3.6 and the release analytics sink is Null. Its advice to drop the video-call claim rather than buy a vendor now is sound.

rejected_claims: The Investor (repeating the checklist): R1-12a still fails. I ran it today and test/qa/round1/r1_defects_test.dart passes 15/15; the test computes the weekday now.

The Believer: AR site pages show 0 placeholders and diverge from EN. They carry the same 7/2/2 under the marker [بانتظار الاستكمال] (class="todo" counts match). The real defect is that the checklist grep and the preflight cannot see that marker.
The Believer: PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy declares only six types without CrashData. NSPrivacyCollectedDataTypeCrashData is declared at line 133.
The Believer: the assistant wire carries no health data, only the question and catalogue. AssistantSubject serialises 'avoid' contraindication tags and 'allergies' (assistant_wire.dart).

App Reviewer: the C09b wording changed in this diff while the version stayed 1. The diff adds only a promise header (O9 lines) and a niqab button; the disclosure bullets are unchanged. A version bump is needed for the accuracy rewrite, not because of this diff.

App Reviewer: 'No man ever sees your face, your card or your name' is false because admins can list flags (main.py:830). Flag rows carry reason codes, not images, the card or a name, and images are never stored. Whether a male admin's console access is acceptable is a counsel question, not a proven false claim.

The Investor F4: 'No analytics software' is a misrepresentation while Crashlytics runs. Crash reporting is disclosed in privacy section 3.6 and the release analytics sink is Null, so the line is true today. The real issue is consent timing (rank 7).
Checklist/Investor: app_router.dart:2274 drops 'talk to a human'. The code is at 2312-2314.
Checklist: OWN-09 relies on 'LAW-20'. There is no LAW-20; the counsel list is LAW-17.
Checklist OWN-01 check 1: `grep "to be completed"` covers site/ar. It does not (AR uses the Arabic marker), so the check is invalid as written.
The Skeptic (guess): the other two preflight FAILs are 'likely the release keystore'. They are the missing key.properties and an empty iOS team id.
must_protect: functions/identity/store.py writes no image, name, birth date or raw NID; images are processed in memory only
NID stored only as a keyed HMAC with a pepper in Secret Manager (store.py:48-52, dedupe.py); one card, one account
Native Crashlytics defaults off: Info.plist:72-73 and AndroidManifest.xml:84-86. Any consent gate depends on this

C09b server-recorded consent gate: app_router.dart:418-422 consentRecorded; no lens opens, deep links included, until the write returns; decline goes to C15; keep kCaptureConsentVersion in step with CONSENT_VERSION
consents collection client-readable and write:false (firestore.rules:910-913); new Terms acceptance must follow the same server-minted pattern
Health backup off by default with its own health-v1 consent, enforced in the rules (firestore.rules:140-156) and withdrawable
Deletion manifest as the single source plus journaled sweeps and resweep (deletion.py, main.py:969-994, config.py:558); unverified women can still delete; the export must reuse the same manifest

Feature flags: community, coachApp, assistant, payments, marketplace and adminConsole off; testingAidsAllowed false with accountRequired. Any reviewer path stays server-side and allow-listed, never a client bypass
Android CAMERA only, with RECORD_AUDIO, storage and c2dm removed; no photo-library entitlement on iOS
Allowlist structured logs with reason codes only (identity/logs.py); ENFORCE_APP_CHECK=True; europe-west3
Analytics: NullAnalyticsSink in release, debug sink only under kDebugMode, G9 cycle-no-analytics test
Site CSP default-src 'none', no scripts and no cookies (site/_headers)
Sex read only from the NID digit, never from the face; neutral rejection copy
Value-first order Welcome > O03 > O05 > C06; the new C06 acceptance is one step and adds no screen; C09b and health consent stay separate from the Terms
Publisher (Mahmoud Reda) and founder or brand face (Rahma Mohsen) kept separate in the terms, privacy and footer
LegalLinks hide-when-empty plus the preflight FAIL on empty links; add a release assert, do not remove the guard
verdict:
Not safe to submit to either store, and not safe to launch in Egypt yet. The engineering underneath is sound and I verified it: images are never stored, the NID is kept only as an HMAC, the C09b gate is server-recorded, health data needs consent in the rules, the deletion engine works, permissions are camera only, the CSP is strict, and tests are green (R1-12a now passes). What fails is consent, disclosure and release paperwork.

Store blockers:
